translation.text: I looked and turned to another part of the earth, and there I saw a deep valley with fire burning.[a]

footnotes.text: Literally, “another face of the earth.” “Another part” preserves the selected word “other” and the geographic face/surface expression. The last clause describes the fire burning; it does not add a second observer or a separate numeral.
